window_rule: Start 340; extend all cases to 380; only extend to 440 if a candidate plateau can be tested or the first pulse is not yet separated. No infinite-bounce search.
event_definition: first local maximum of magnetic fraction above 0.01*p_scalar_initial^2; width is its connected half-maximum interval
clock: minus change of log spatial volume r+sigma on each fixed-y normal curve; not a propagating front
plateau_rule: duration at least one resolved event width; full spectrum drift and integrated absolute matter and spatial contributions each <=1e-4; normalized matter and spatial fractions <=1e-4; checked against window extension
spectral_definition: sorted geometric eigenvalues and sqrt(2)*n(psi)/abs(K), contraction toward increasing T
same_incidence_wall_rule: Only after both platforms qualify: use fitted incoming geometric spectrum, scalar value and local magnetic strength; retain physical magnetic axis before sorting
independent_check: FD6/DOP853 interaction segment and direct four-dimensional jets, shared early checkpoint explicitly marked
